questions.prompt: Which command discovers all custom actions supported by an application named 'db'?
questions.explanation: 'juju actions <application>' lists all actions defined by the charm and available to run.

questions.prompt: How do you run the 'backup' action on unit 'db/0' in Juju 3.x?
questions.explanation: In Juju 3.x+, 'juju run <target> <action-name>' executes defined charm actions.

questions.prompt: Which command executes an ad-hoc shell command (e.g. 'uptime') across all units of application 'worker'?
questions.explanation: 'juju exec --application <name>' executes raw shell commands on all units belonging to that application.
